item.title: [26 Nov] "How I Did 4 Years of Work in 4 months"
item.description:
When: Thursday 26 November 2026, 20:00
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Athens tech · Meetup

Agentic engineering is building software by directing AI coding agents rather than writing the code yourself. The engineering part comes from how you direct the agents - the goal, the rules, the checks, the coding standards, the tests, the code reviews etc. It speeds things up a lot as Agents are incredibly quick at producing code, much faster than humans, and it allows you much more flexibility in what you build, as you are not just limited to your own knowledge, language or domain expertise. The more time consuming part now, is not the writing code, but the verifying, the testing, the workflow you use to ensure code quality and goal adherence. item.description:
When: Friday 27 November 2026, 21:00
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

AI for DevOps & SRE: From Impressive Demos to Operational Trust What would make you trust an AI agent with operational changes? An agent can generate a valid command and still misunderstand the objective. It can mistake missing telemetry for a healthy service, or choose an action outside the scope you authorized. How do we recognize these failures before they affect real systems? Join Bucharest XDevOps Meetup for a practical, vendor-neutral session exploring the risks of AI-assisted operations and the controls that help manage them.
